messages:
sara: Heads up — need input on where we surface the 'change evidence' download CTA in the console and how routing + quotas should behave when tenants request large exports. example: tenant requests a 5-day change backlog. do we enqueue or try immediate? :thinking:
kevin: my 2¢: show an inbox entry with presigned link + TTL, but create async and send webhook when ready. avoid blocking UI thread.
maria: agreed. security wants short-lived links by default. TTL 1h vs 24h?
sara: 1h is safer but might break long-running analysis. maybe 24h for enterprise, 1h for self-serve.
ops-bot: export_job_879 queued by sara. status: pending.
kevin: quotas: per-tenant export quota + global concurrent export cap. if cap hit, we should queue and expose ETA + option to cancel. also return quota headers so clients can retry intelligently.
sara: UX: show size estimate, ETA, and a modal option to redact PII before generation. small toggle.
maria: KMS note: presigned URL points to S3 object signed by infra. the bundle itself should be encrypted with tenant KMS key. also record who clicked the link in audit.
kevin: debate: API should default to pseudonymize actor data in downloads. security prefers pseudonymization unless tenant enables full actor resolution. storing mapping in a separate secure ledger sounds right.
sara: yes — in console we should surface that the download will contain pseudonymized actors unless you opt-in. must record consent in audit export metadata.
maria: telemetry: emit export_event.start, export_event.complete, export_event.size_bytes, export_event.actor_resolution. add trace id to correlate with request SLOs.
kevin: performance: large exports should stream to S3 with ndjson chunking rather than buffering in memory. workers should upload parts as they go.
sara: rollout plan: behind feature-flag for enterprise tier first. canary 5% tenants for 24h, monitor latency and error-rate.
maria: sampling vs full retention: legal/regulatory customers need full chain, others can be sampled for cheaper storage/ops. make sampling configurable per-tenant.
kevin: API contract: include versioning. example response: {"export_id":"e-123","status":"queued","version":"v1"}. do not change shapes post-GA.
sara: when presigned link expires, console should show archived view with an action to re-request a new export. keep audit record of reissues.
maria: KMS rotation concern: include signing metadata (key id, signature algorithm, signed_at) in bundle so old proofs remain verifiable after rotation.
kevin: ownership: eng-platform owns UX and API; eng-infra owns storage/KMS and worker scaling. need oncall runbook for export failures.
sara: action items: maria — draft minimal API proto + example payload; kevin — quota and concurrency proposal; ops — add runbook and retention policy; i'll mock UI affordances and telemetry fields.
ops-bot: export_job_879 status: queued -> assigned to worker-12.
kevin: small suggestion — surface remaining export tokens in response headers so clients can adapt.
maria: add corporate/legal flag to force full audit retention for regulated tenants.
sara: great. i'll schedule a quick sync in 30m to review drafts. thanks :thumbsup:
